title: Case definitions
summary: For a source-authored plan, export cases from a clean merged source using its declared target; retain the exporter's full source_revision with cases. Sync that export to bind the plan or recover, then reread and check the plan against source. Once bound, a plan whose cases the Yoke build generates converges on server boot to that build's cases and commit, moving only forward; a failure keeps the cases and logs qa_plan_source_convergence_failed with its recovery. A release run pins each attached post-deploy plan at its first plan group in the run, and the deployed candidate must contain the plan's source revision; plan edits during a release wait for the next release. Existing requirements, runs and evidence keep their recorded rows. Older engines may refuse qa_plan_source_binding_unavailable before writing. Manual case arrays go through yoke qa plan-cases replace, which refuses an exporter document or --source-revision as qa_plan_source_sync_required and a source-bound plan as qa_plan_source_revision_required. Every case is self-contained: it brings its own access, fixtures and public surface and never relies on the runner's steering seat, claim or session, so a seat-only read such as yoke steering report get cannot run in item QA.
recipes: yoke qa plan-cases sync --project P --plan-id N --cases-file SOURCE_EXPORT --json
verification: The canonical installer-campaign maintenance home owns export, boot convergence and post-sync checks. Source help, boot convergence and release refresh tests inspected; no saved plan, requirement or execution changed.
